full_judgment: 3. The suit was filed stating, inter alia, that the land in suit belong to Karunakanta Roy and others and they settled the land in suit to Amir Ali Kazi and his brother sayed Kazi in 1342 B.S. and that on the death of the aforesaid 2 settlement holders their heirs became owner of the land in suit, that R.S. record was prepared in the name of Zaminder and thereupon Amir Ali Kazi filed Miscellaneous case under section 143 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act in the office of the Sub-Division Manager and Revenue Officer Acquired Estate, Bogra on December 24, 1966 and thereupon record of right was correctly prepared by the order of January 30, 1967, that some time after the order allowing the correction of the record Amir Ali Kazi died and that the heirs of All were not aware of the order for correction of the record, that in the first part of June 1984 plaintiff No.1 came to know about the order for correction of the record and thereupon obtained the certified copy on June 14. 1984, that MRR khatian having not been prepared in the name of the predecessor of the plaintiffs some greedy persons of the locality tried to grab the property in suit, that the kabala in the name of the defendant No.2 is forged, that plaintiffs are in possession of the pond and rearing fish and that also possessing the bank of the tank by cultivating vegetable, that as the wrong record of right has given rise to serious complications in the enjoyment of the property by the plaintiffs and also clouded title of the plaintiffs they are constrained to file the suit.
